translations.literal: He was from the same district as Qichong, Xu Wenhua, and An Pan—at the time called "the Four Remonstrators of Jiading."
translations.idiomatic: He was from the same home district as Qichong, Xu Wenhua, and An Pan; together they were known as "the Four Remonstrators of Jiading."

sentences.zh: 鄭自璧，字采東，祥符人，隸籍京師。

translations.literal: Zheng Zibi, styled Caidong, was from Xiangfu, enrolled in the capital household register.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zibi, courtesy name Caidong, was from Xiangfu but registered as a resident of the capital.

sentences.zh: 正德十二年進士。

translations.literal: A presented scholar in the twelfth year of Zhengde.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the twelfth year of the Zhengde reign.

sentences.zh: 改庶吉士，除工科給事中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Hanlin Bachelor and then appointed Drafter of the Ministry of Works Section.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor and was then appointed drafter of the Ministry of Works section.

sentences.zh: 世宗踐阼，中外競言時政。

translations.literal: When the Shizong took the throne, inside and outside the court competed to speak on current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jiajing Emperor ascended the throne, officials throughout the empire vied to speak on affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 自璧請采有關化理者，類輯成書，以備觀覽，從之。

translations.literal: Zibi requested collecting matters relevant to transformation and governance, compiling them by category into a book for reference—the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Zibi asked that memorials bearing on moral governance be collected and arranged into a book for the emperor's reading. The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 初，正德中，奄人多奪民業為莊田，至是因民訴，遣使往勘。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the Zhengde era, eunuchs often seized civilian property for estate farms; now, because of civilian complaints, envoys were sent to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhengde Emperor, eunuchs had often seized commoners' land for private estates. Now, responding to popular complaints, the court sent investigators.

sentences.zh: 自璧復備言其弊，帝命勘者嚴治，民患稍除。

translations.literal: Zibi again elaborated on the abuses; the emperor ordered the investigators to punish strictly, and the people's troubles were somewhat relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Zibi again laid out the abuses in detail. The emperor ordered strict punishment, and the people's grievances were partly eased.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年，後父陳萬言辭黃華坊賜第，請西安門外新宅，詔予之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiajing, the empress's father Chen Wanyan declined the residence granted at Huanghua Lane and requested a new house outside Xi'an Gate—the edict granted it.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jiajing, the empress's father Chen Wanyan declined the mansion at Huanghua Lane and asked for a new residence outside Xi'an Gate. An edict granted his request.

sentences.zh: 自璧以所請宅已鬻之民，不當奪，與安磐力爭。

translations.literal: Zibi argued that the requested house had already been sold to commoners and ought not be seized; he contested forcefully with An Pan.
translations.idiomatic: Zibi argued that the house in question had already been sold to commoners and must not be seized. He and An Pan protested vigorously.

sentences.zh: 不聽。

translations.literal: The emperor did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 明年爭「大禮」受杖。

translations.literal: The next year, contesting the "Great Rites," he was beaten with the rod.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was beaten for opposing the "Great Rites."

sentences.zh: 三遷至兵科都給事中。

translations.literal: After three promotions he reached Chief Drafter of the Ministry of War Section.
translations.idiomatic: After three promotions he became chief drafter of the Ministry of War section.

sentences.zh: 中官李能以修墩堡為詞，請定山海關稅額。

translations.literal: Eunuch Li Neng, on the pretext of repairing fortresses, requested fixing the tax quota at Shanhai Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Li Neng, citing repairs to frontier forts, asked to fix the customs quota at Shanhai Pass.

sentences.zh: 中官張忠、尚書金獻民等論甘肅功，蔭子錦衣，其下參隨皆進秩。

translations.literal: Eunuch Zhang Zhong, Minister Jin Xianmin, and others discussed Gansu merit; sons were ennobled in the Brocade Guard, and all their attending subordinates received promotions.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Zhang Zhong, Minister Jin Xianmin, and others reported merit in Gansu. Sons were ennobled in the Brocade Guard, and every attendant in their retinues was promoted.

sentences.zh: 鎮守江西中官黎鑒，參隨逾常額。

translations.literal: Li Jian, the eunuch military commissioner in Jiangxi, had attending subordinates exceeding the usual quota.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jian, the eunuch commissioner in Jiangxi, kept more attendants than regulations allowed.

sentences.zh: 中官武忠從子英冒功，擢副千戶。

translations.literal: Ying, nephew of eunuch Wu Zhong, falsely claimed merit and was promoted to vice thousand-household.
translations.idiomatic: Ying, nephew of eunuch Wu Zhong, falsely claimed military credit and was promoted to vice thousand-household.

sentences.zh: 錦衣官裁革者多夤緣復職，而司禮監奏收已汰諸匠近五百人。

translations.literal: Many dismissed from Brocade Guard offices regained posts through connections, while the Directorate of Ceremonial memorialized to take back nearly five hundred craftsmen already eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: Many officials cut from the Brocade Guard regained their posts through patronage, while the Directorate of Ceremonial asked to reinstate nearly five hundred craftsmen already dismissed.

sentences.zh: 孝陵凈軍於喜擅赴京奏辨。

translations.literal: Yu Xi of the Xiaoling Pure Guard arbitrarily went to the capital to plead his case.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xi of the Xiaoling Pure Guard went to the capital on his own authority to plead his case.

sentences.zh: 安邊伯許泰戍死，其子請襲祖職。

translations.literal: Border-pacifying Marquis Xu Tai died on frontier service; his son requested inheriting the ancestral post.
translations.idiomatic: Border-pacifying Marquis Xu Tai died on frontier duty; his son asked to inherit the family title.

sentences.zh: 中官扶安黃英先後死，官其親屬。

translations.literal: Eunuchs Fu An and Huang Ying died in succession; their relatives were given official posts.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuchs Fu An and Huang Ying died in turn, and their relatives were given official posts.

sentences.zh: 自璧皆抗疏爭，帝多不聽。

translations.literal: On all these matters Zibi memorialized in protest; the emperor mostly did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Zibi protested all of these by memorial; the emperor usually refused.

sentences.zh: 嘗偕同官劾郭勛奸貪。

translations.literal: He once joined colleagues in impeaching Guo Xun for wickedness and greed.
translations.idiomatic: He once joined his colleagues in impeaching Guo Xun for corruption and treachery.

sentences.zh: 及李福達事起，復劾勛交結妖人。

translations.literal: When the Li Fuda affair arose, he again impeached Xun for consorting with sorcerers.
translations.idiomatic: When the Li Fuda case broke, he again impeached Xun for consorting with sorcerers.

sentences.zh: 帝以勛故，降旨責自璧。

translations.literal: Because of Xun, the emperor issued an edict rebuking Zibi.
translations.idiomatic: For Xun's sake the emperor issued an edict rebuking Zibi.

sentences.zh: 六年三月，宣府失事。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year, Xuanfu suffered a military disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the sixth year, the frontier command at Xuanfu suffered a defeat.

sentences.zh: 復劾總兵傅鐸，並及鎮守中官王玳、巡撫周金、副將時陳等罪。

translations.literal: He again impeached Commander-in-Chief Fu Duo, also implicating the frontier commissioner eunuch Wang Dai, Grand Coordinator Zhou Jin, Vice Commander Shi Chen, and others.
translations.idiomatic: He again impeached the commander Fu Duo, and also charged the frontier eunuch Wang Dai, Grand Coordinator Zhou Jin, Vice Commander Shi Chen, and others.

sentences.zh: 鐸逮問，陳褫冠帶，而玳、金責立功贖罪。

translations.literal: Duo was arrested for questioning; Chen was stripped of cap and belt; Dai and Jin were ordered to redeem guilt through meritorious service.
translations.idiomatic: Duo was arrested and interrogated; Chen was stripped of rank; Dai and Jin were ordered to redeem themselves through service.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎桂萼請起王瓊於邊。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Gui E requested recalling Wang Qiong to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Rites Gui E asked that Wang Qiong be recalled to frontier service.

sentences.zh: 自璧率同官與御史譚纘等言瓊罪宜追治，萼引奸邪，請並論。

translations.literal: Zibi led colleagues and Censor Tan Zuan and others in saying Qiong's crimes ought to be pursued; E had introduced the wicked and ought to be prosecuted as well.
translations.idiomatic: Zibi led his colleagues and Censor Tan Zuan and others in arguing that Qiong's crimes should be pursued and that E, who had promoted a villain, should be prosecuted as well.

sentences.zh: 不納。

translations.literal: The proposal was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The court rejected the proposal.

sentences.zh: 自璧最敢言，所言皆權幸，直聲震朝野。

translations.literal: Zibi was boldest in speech; what he said always targeted powerful favorites, and his upright reputation shook court and countryside.
translations.idiomatic: Zibi was the boldest of speakers. He aimed always at the powerful and the favored, and his reputation for integrity resounded through court and country.

sentences.zh: 側目者共為蜚語，聞於上。

translations.literal: Those who glared at him together spread slander until it reached the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Those who resented him spread slander together until it reached the emperor's ears.

sentences.zh: 吏部以資推太仆少卿，不用。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel, on grounds of seniority, recommended him as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Stud—but he was not appointed.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel recommended him for vice director of the Court of the Imperial Stud on grounds of seniority, but he was passed over.

sentences.zh: 至是科道共劾，中旨降二級，調外任，遂謫江陰縣丞。

translations.literal: At this time censorial officials jointly impeached him; by palace edict he was demoted two ranks, transferred to external post, and then banished to assistant magistrate of Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: Then the censorial officials jointly impeached him. By secret edict he was demoted two ranks, sent to a provincial post, and finally relegated to assistant magistrate of Jiangyin.

sentences.zh: 命下，大臣幸其去，無救者。

translations.literal: When the order issued, grand ministers were glad to see him go, and none intervened.
translations.idiomatic: When the order came down, senior officials were glad to see him go, and no one spoke for him.

sentences.zh: 後廷臣屢論薦，竟不召。

translations.literal: Later court officials repeatedly recommended him, but he was never recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Later, court officials recommended him again and again, but he was never summoned back.

sentences.zh: 戚賢，字秀夫，全椒人。

translations.literal: Qi Xian, styled Xiufu, was from Quanjiao.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Xian, courtesy name Xiufu, was from Quanjiao.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖五年進士。

translations.literal: A presented scholar in the fifth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the fifth year of the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 授歸安知縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Gui'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Gui'an.

sentences.zh: 縣有蕭總管廟，報賽無虛日。

translations.literal: The county had a Temple of Administrator Xiao, with thanksgiving offerings not a day without vacancy.
translations.idiomatic: The county had a Temple of Administrator Xiao, and offerings of thanks were made there every day.

sentences.zh: 會久早，賢禱不驗，沈本偶於河。

translations.literal: When a long drought came, Xian's prayers went unanswered; he sank the idol in the river.
translations.idiomatic: During a long drought his prayers went unanswered, so he sank the temple idol in the river.

sentences.zh: 居數日，舟過其地，木偶躍入舟，舟中人皆驚。

translations.literal: Several days later a boat passed that spot; the wooden image leaped into the boat and all aboard were alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: A few days later a boat passed the spot. The wooden image leaped into the boat and terrified everyone aboard.

sentences.zh: 賢徐笑曰：「是特未焚耳。

translations.literal: Xian smiled slowly and said: "This simply has not been burned yet.
translations.idiomatic: Xian smiled and said calmly: "It simply has not been burned yet.

sentences.zh: 」趣焚之。

translations.literal: " He hurried to burn it.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered it burned at once.

sentences.zh: 潛令健隸入岸傍社，誡之曰：「水中人出，械以來。

translations.literal: Secretly he ordered stout attendants to enter the shore-side shrine society and warned them: "When men come out of the water, seize them with shackles and bring them.
translations.idiomatic: Secretly he posted strong attendants at the shrine on the bank with orders: "When men come out of the water, seize them in shackles and bring them here.

sentences.zh: 」已，果獲數人。

translations.literal: " Before long several men were indeed captured.
translations.idiomatic: " Before long several men were captured.

sentences.zh: 蓋奸民募善泅者為之也。

translations.literal: It turned out scoundrels had hired good swimmers to perform the feat.
translations.idiomatic: Scoundrels had hired skilled swimmers to stage the miracle.

sentences.zh: 知府萬雲鵬操下急，賢數忤之。

translations.literal: Prefect Wan Yunpeng was harsh in handling subordinates; Xian repeatedly defied him.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Wan Yunpeng was harsh with his subordinates, and Xian repeatedly crossed him.

sentences.zh: 當上計，有毀雲鵬者，將被黜。

translations.literal: At the time of the annual review, someone slandered Yunpeng and he was about to be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: At the annual evaluation someone slandered Yunpeng, and he was about to be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 賢走吏部白其枉，雲鵬竟得免。

translations.literal: Xian went to the Ministry of Personnel to declare his innocence; Yunpeng was spared after all.
translations.idiomatic: Xian went to the Ministry of Personnel to declare Yunpeng innocent, and Yunpeng was spared after all.

sentences.zh: 而尚書桂萼獨心異賢，喪去，起知唐縣。

translations.literal: But Minister Gui E alone took a contrary view of Xian; after mourning leave he was reappointed magistrate of Tang County.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Gui E alone took a dislike to Xian. After a period of mourning leave, Xian was reappointed magistrate of Tang County.

sentences.zh: 召為吏科給事中。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Drafter of the Ministry of Personnel Section.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to the capital as drafter of the Ministry of Personnel section.

sentences.zh: 十四年春，當大計外吏。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourteenth year, it was time for the grand evaluation of external officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourteenth year came the triennial evaluation of provincial officials.

sentences.zh: 大計罷者，例永不用，而是時言事諸臣忤柄臣意，率假計典錮之。

translations.literal: Those dismissed in the grand evaluation were by precedent never reemployed; but at this time remonstrating officials who offended powerful ministers were mostly barred through the evaluation ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Officials dismissed in the grand evaluation were by precedent never reemployed. Now, however, remonstrating officials who had offended the men in power were being purged through the evaluation itself.

sentences.zh: 賢乃先事言所黜有未當者，宜聽言官論救。

translations.literal: Xian therefore spoke beforehand that where dismissals were improper, remonstrating officials ought to be allowed to petition in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Xian therefore proposed in advance that where dismissals were unjust, remonstrating officials should be allowed to appeal on the accused men's behalf.

sentences.zh: 帝稱善，從其請。

translations.literal: The emperor praised it and granted the request.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved and granted his request.

sentences.zh: 會參議王存、韋商臣言事忤要人，前給事中葉洪劾汪鋐被謫，果在黜中。

translations.literal: Just then Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Cun and Wei Shangchen offended powerful men by speaking on affairs; former Drafter Ye Hong, who had impeached Wang Qiong, was banished—they indeed appeared among the dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Cun and Wei Shangchen had offended powerful men by their remonstrances, and former drafter Ye Hong, who had impeached Wang Qiong, had been banished. They indeed appeared on the dismissal list.

sentences.zh: 賢方勘事陜西，給事中薛宗鎧因據賢疏伸救。

translations.literal: Xian was then on inspection duty in Shaanxi; Drafter Xue Zongkai appealed for relief citing Xian's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Xian was then on inspection duty in Shaanxi. Drafter Xue Zongkai appealed for their reinstatement, citing Xian's earlier memorial.

sentences.zh: 吏部持不可，帝遂命已之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel held that it could not be done; the Emperor then ordered the matter stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel objected that it could not be done, and the Emperor ordered the matter dropped.

sentences.zh: 及賢還朝，以鋐恣橫，實張孚敬庇之，乃條其罪狀曰：「輔臣孚敬布腹心以操吏部之權，懸利害以箝言官之口。

translations.literal: When Xian returned to court, seeing Qiong's overbearing conduct and that in truth Zhang Fujing sheltered him, he itemized the crimes, saying: "Chief Minister Fujing posts confidants to wield the Ministry of Personnel's power, and dangles gain and harm to clamp shut the mouths of remonstrating officials.
translations.idiomatic: When Xian returned to court, he saw that Qiong's arrogance owed everything to Zhang Fujing's protection. He laid out the charges in a memorial: "Chief Minister Fujing stations his own men to control the Ministry of Personnel and dangles reward and ruin to silence the remonstrating officials.

sentences.zh: 即如考察一事，陛下曲聽臣言，許其申雪，正防大臣行私也。

translations.literal: Take the matter of evaluation alone: Your Majesty bent to hear my words and permitted them to clear their names—precisely to guard against grand ministers acting for private ends.
translations.idiomatic: Take the evaluation alone. Your Majesty bent to hear me and allowed the wronged to clear their names—precisely to keep grand ministers from acting for private ends.

sentences.zh: 今言官為洪等辯救，孚敬乃曲庇冢臣，巧言阻遏。

translations.literal: Now remonstrating officials speak in defense of Hong and the others, yet Fujing bends to shelter his chief minister and blocks them with clever words.
translations.idiomatic: Now the remonstrating officials speak in defense of Hong and the others, yet Fujing bends to shield his favored minister and blocks them with clever words.

sentences.zh: 陛下有堯、舜知人之明，輔臣負伯鯀方命之罪。

translations.literal: Your Majesty possesses the discernment of Yao and Shun in knowing men; the chief minister bears the crime of Gun defying orders.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has the discernment of Yao and Shun in knowing men, yet the chief minister bears the crime of Gun, who defied Heaven's command.

sentences.zh: 放流之典具在，惟陛下以威斷之。

translations.literal: The precedents for banishment stand ready; may Your Majesty act with resolute authority.
translations.idiomatic: The precedents for banishment are all in place. May Your Majesty act with resolute authority alone.

sentences.zh: 」帝內嘉賢言，而重違孚敬、鋐意，洪等竟不復。

translations.literal: The Emperor inwardly approved Xian's words, but heavily weighed going against Fujing and Qiong's wishes; Hong and the others were never restored after all.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor inwardly approved what Xian said, but he was reluctant to cross Fujing and Qiong. Hong and the others were never restored.

sentences.zh: 再以喪去。

translations.literal: Again he left office on mourning leave.
translations.idiomatic: He again left office to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 補刑科都給事中。

translations.literal: He was appointed Chief Drafter of the Punishments Section.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed chief drafter of the Punishments section.

sentences.zh: 夏言柄國，會當選庶吉士，不能無所徇。

translations.literal: When Xia Yan held national power, the selection of Hanlin probationers fell due, and he could not entirely avoid partiality.
translations.idiomatic: While Xia Yan held the reins of state, Hanlin probationers were due to be chosen, and he could not entirely avoid favoritism.

sentences.zh: 賢疏陳請屬之弊，帝納其言。

translations.literal: Xian memorialized detailing the evils of soliciting patronage; the Emperor accepted his view.
translations.idiomatic: Xian memorialized on the evils of soliciting patronage, and the Emperor accepted his argument.

sentences.zh: 久之，劾郭勛吞噬遍天下。

translations.literal: After some time he impeached Guo Xun for devouring everything under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he impeached Guo Xun for preying on the realm from end to end.

sentences.zh: 太廟災，復劾勛及尚書張瓚、樊繼祖等，而薦聞淵、熊浹、劉天和、王畿、程文德、徐樾、萬鏜、呂柟、魏校、程啟充、馬明衡、魏良弼、葉洪、王臣可任用。

translations.literal: When the Imperial Ancestral Temple burned, he again impeached Xun along with Ministers Zhang Zan and Fan Jizu, and recommended Wen Yuan, Xiong Jia, Liu Tianhe, Wang Ji, Cheng Wende, Xu Yue, Wan Tong, Lü Shan, Wei Xiao, Cheng Qichong, Ma Mingheng, Wei Liangbi, Ye Hong, and Wang Chen as fit for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: When the Imperial Ancestral Temple burned, he again impeached Xun along with Ministers Zhang Zan and Fan Jizu, and recommended Wen Yuan, Xiong Jia, Liu Tianhe, Wang Ji, Cheng Wende, Xu Yue, Wan Tong, Lü Shan, Wei Xiao, Cheng Qichong, Ma Mingheng, Wei Liangbi, Ye Hong, and Wang Chen as men fit for office.

sentences.zh: 言滋不悅，激帝怒，謫山東布政司都事。

translations.literal: Yan grew ever more displeased, stirred the Emperor's anger, and had him banished to Chief Clerk of the Shandong Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Yan grew ever more displeased, roused the Emperor's anger, and had him banished to chief clerk of the Shandong provincial administration commission.

sentences.zh: 諸被薦者皆奪俸。

translations.literal: All those he had recommended had their salaries cut.
translations.idiomatic: All those he had recommended had their salaries suspended.

sentences.zh: 賢尋以父老自免。

translations.literal: Before long Xian resigned on grounds of aged parents.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Xian resigned on the grounds that his parents were old.

sentences.zh: 歸十余年，卒。

translations.literal: He returned home for more than ten years, then died.
translations.idiomatic: He lived at home for more than ten years, then died.

sentences.zh: 賢少聞王守仁說，心契之。

translations.literal: In youth Xian heard Wang Shouren's teachings and his heart resonated with them.
translations.idiomatic: In youth Xian heard Wang Shouren's teachings and found his heart in accord with them.

sentences.zh: 及官於浙，遂執弟子禮。

translations.literal: When he served as an official in Zhejiang, he took the role of a disciple.
translations.idiomatic: When he served in Zhejiang he took up the duties of a disciple toward him.

sentences.zh: 劉繪，字子素，一字少質，光州人。

translations.literal: Liu Hui, styled Zisu, also styled Shaozhi, was from Guang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hui, courtesy name Zisu, also known as Shaozhi, was from Guang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 祖進，太仆少卿。

translations.literal: His grandfather Jin was Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Jin had been vice director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 繪長身修髯，磊落負奇氣。

translations.literal: Hui was tall with a long beard, open and bold, bearing an uncommon spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Hui was tall and long-bearded, open and bold, with an uncommon spirit about him.

sentences.zh: 好擊劍，力挽六石弓。

translations.literal: He loved swordplay and could draw a six-stone bow.
translations.idiomatic: He loved swordplay and could draw a six-stone bow.

sentences.zh: 舉鄉試第一，登嘉靖十四年進士，授行人，改戶科給事中。

translations.literal: He placed first in the provincial examination, passed the metropolitan examination in the fourteenth year of Jiajing, was appointed Courier, and was transferred to Drafter of the Revenue Section.
translations.idiomatic: He placed first in the provincial examination and passed the metropolitan examination in the fourteenth year of the Jiajing reign. He was appointed courier, then transferred to drafter of the Revenue section.

sentences.zh: 二十年，詔兩京言官會薦邊才。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year an edict ordered remonstrating officials of both capitals jointly to recommend frontier talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year an edict ordered remonstrating officials of both capitals to recommend frontier talent jointly.

sentences.zh: 給事中邢如默等薦毛伯溫、劉天和等二十人，而故御史段汝礪、副都御史翟瓚、參議王洙與焉。

translations.literal: Drafter Xing Rumo and others recommended twenty men including Mao Bowen and Liu Tianhe, and among them were former Censor Duan Rushi, Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhai Zan, and Vice Censor Wang Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: Drafter Xing Rumo and others recommended twenty men, including Mao Bowen and Liu Tianhe. Among them were former censor Duan Rushi, vice censor-in-chief Zhai Zan, and vice censor Wang Zhu.

sentences.zh: 繪言：「汝礪乃大學士翟鑾姻戚，瓚、洙則夏言諭指如默排群議而薦之者。

translations.literal: Hui said: "Rushi is a relation by marriage of Grand Secretary Zhai Luan; Zan and Zhu were recommended because Xia Yan instructed Rumo to override the collective opinion and put their names forward.
translations.idiomatic: Hui said: "Rushi is a relation by marriage of Grand Secretary Zhai Luan. Zan and Zhu were put forward because Xia Yan instructed Rumo to override the collective opinion and recommend them.

sentences.zh: 相臣挾權以遏言官，言官懼勢而咈公議，上下雷同，非社稷福。

translations.literal: The chief minister wields power to check remonstrating officials; remonstrating officials fear that power and oppose public opinion; above and below echo one another—this is no blessing to the altars of state.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister wields power to silence remonstrating officials; the remonstrating officials fear that power and turn against public opinion. When high and low echo one another alike, the altars of state are not served.

sentences.zh: 乞罷鑾、言，罪如默，為徇私植黨者戒。

translations.literal: I beg that Luan and Yan be dismissed, Rumo be punished, and that this serve as a warning to those who favor their own and build factions.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that Luan and Yan be dismissed and Rumo be punished, as a warning to those who favor their own and build factions.

sentences.zh: 」帝是其言，出如默於外。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved his words and sent Rumo out to an external post.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved his argument and sent Rumo to an external post.

sentences.zh: 言適罷政，鑾置不問。

translations.literal: Yan had just been removed from power; Luan was left untouched.
translations.idiomatic: Yan had just been removed from power, and Luan was left untouched.

sentences.zh: 明年，寇大入山西。

translations.literal: The next year the enemy raided deeply into Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the raiders drove deep into Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 繪上疏曰：「俺答方強，必為腹心患。

translations.literal: Hui submitted a memorial saying: "Altan is now strong and is sure to become a heartland threat.
translations.idiomatic: Hui submitted a memorial saying: "Altan is strong now and is sure to become a threat at the empire's heart.

sentences.zh: 議者謂宜守不宜戰，以故邊將多自全，或拾殘騎報首功。

translations.literal: Counselors say one should defend and not fight; hence frontier generals mostly preserve themselves, or gather broken riders and report them as heads for merit.
translations.idiomatic: Counselors say the frontier should hold, not fight. Frontier generals mostly look to their own safety, or gather up broken bands of riders and report them as enemy heads for merit.

sentences.zh: 督巡諸臣亦第列士馬守要害，名曰清野，實則避鋒；

translations.literal: The supervising and touring officials likewise merely array troops and horses to hold key points—called clearing the countryside, in fact avoiding the enemy's edge;
translations.idiomatic: The supervising and touring officials likewise merely array troops and horses at key points. They call it clearing the countryside; in fact they avoid the enemy's edge.

sentences.zh: 名曰守險，實則自衛。

translations.literal: called holding the passes, in fact protecting themselves.
translations.idiomatic: They call it holding the passes; in fact they are protecting themselves.

sentences.zh: 請專任翟鵬，得便宜從事。

translations.literal: I ask that Zhai Peng alone be entrusted with full authority to act at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Zhai Peng be given sole charge, with full authority to act at discretion.

sentences.zh: 馳發宣、大、山西士馬，合十七八萬人。

translations.literal: Dispatch at speed the troops and horses of Xuanfu, Datong, and Shanxi, totaling one hundred seventy or eighty thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatch at speed the troops and horses of Xuanfu, Datong, and Shanxi—one hundred seventy or eighty thousand men in all.

sentences.zh: 三路並舉，有進無退，寇雖多，可計日平也。

translations.literal: Advance on three routes together, advance without retreat; though the enemy be many, they can be pacified within countable days.
translations.idiomatic: Advance on three routes at once, with advance and no retreat. However many the enemy, they can be pacified within days.

sentences.zh: 」帝壯其言。

translations.literal: The Emperor was impressed by his words.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was impressed by what he said.

sentences.zh: 令假鵬便宜，得戮都指揮以下。

translations.literal: He ordered that Peng be granted discretionary authority and empowered to execute regional commanders and below.
translations.idiomatic: He granted Peng discretionary authority and the power to execute regional commanders and men below them.

sentences.zh: 然鵬竟不能出塞。

translations.literal: Yet in the end Peng could not cross beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in the end Peng never crossed beyond the frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 頃之，劾山西巡撫劉臬結納夏言，且請罷吏部尚書許瓚、宣府巡撫楚書。

translations.literal: Before long he impeached Shanxi Grand Coordinator Liu Nao for forming ties with Xia Yan, and also asked that Minister of Personnel Xu Zan and Xuanfu Grand Coordinator Chu Shu be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he impeached Shanxi grand coordinator Liu Nao for forming ties with Xia Yan, and also asked that Minister of Personnel Xu Zan and Xuanfu grand coordinator Chu Shu be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 臬、書由是去職。

translations.literal: Nao and Shu thereupon left their posts.
translations.idiomatic: Nao and Shu thereupon left office.

sentences.zh: 繪兩劾言，言憾之，出為重慶知府。

translations.literal: Hui twice impeached Yan; Yan resented him and had him sent out as prefect of Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: Hui impeached Yan twice. Yan resented him and had him sent out as prefect of Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 土官爭地相讎，檄諭之，即定。

translations.literal: Native chieftains disputed land and nursed mutual vendettas; he sent proclamations instructing them, and the matter was settled at once.
translations.idiomatic: Native chieftains disputed land and nursed mutual vendettas. He sent proclamations instructing them, and the matter was settled at once.

sentences.zh: 上官交薦，而言再入政府，屬言者論罷之。

translations.literal: Superiors repeatedly recommended him, but when Yan re-entered government he had remonstrators impeach him and had him dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Superiors repeatedly recommended him, but when Yan returned to government he had remonstrators impeach him and had him dismissed.

sentences.zh: 家居二十年，卒。

translations.literal: He lived at home twenty years, then died.
translations.idiomatic: He lived at home for twenty years, then died.

sentences.zh: 子黃裳，兵部員外郎。

translations.literal: His son Huang Shang was a Vice Director in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: His son Huang Shang was a vice director in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 倭陷朝鮮，命贊畫侍郎宋應昌軍務。

translations.literal: When Japan invaded Korea, he was ordered to assist Vice Minister Song Yingchang in managing military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Japan invaded Korea, he was ordered to assist Vice Minister Song Yingchang in managing military affairs.

sentences.zh: 渡鴨綠江，抵平壤，大敗賊兵。

translations.literal: He crossed the Yalu River, reached Pyongyang, and routed the bandit army.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed the Yalu River, reached Pyongyang, and routed the enemy army.

sentences.zh: 賊遁，黃裳追逐，又連破之。

translations.literal: The bandits fled; Huang Shang pursued and repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy fled. Huang Shang pursued and defeated them again and again.

sentences.zh: 錄功，進郎中。

translations.literal: His merit was recorded and he was promoted to Director.
translations.idiomatic: His merit was recorded and he was promoted to director.

sentences.zh: 錢薇，字懋垣，海鹽人。

translations.literal: Qian Wei, styled Maoyuan, was from Haiyan.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Wei, courtesy name Maoyuan, was from Haiyan.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十一年進士。

translations.literal: A presented scholar in the eleventh year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the eleventh year of the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 受業湛若水。

translations.literal: He studied under Zhan Ruoshui.
translations.idiomatic: He studied under Zhan Ruoshui.

sentences.zh: 官行人，泊然自守。

translations.literal: Serving as Courier, he was tranquil and kept himself intact.
translations.idiomatic: As courier he lived quietly and held himself apart.

sentences.zh: 與同年生蔣信輩朝夕問學。

translations.literal: With his examination-year fellows Jiang Xin and others he pursued learning morning and evening.
translations.idiomatic: With his examination-year fellows Jiang Xin and others he pursued learning morning and evening.

sentences.zh: 擢禮科給事中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Drafter of the Rites Section.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to drafter of the Rites section.

sentences.zh: 請令將帥家丁得自耕塞下田，毋征其賦，總督大臣假便宜，專制閫外。

translations.literal: He asked that generals' household retainers be allowed to farm frontier lands themselves without tax levied, and that grand coordinators be granted discretionary authority and sole command beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that generals' household retainers be allowed to farm frontier lands without tax, and that grand coordinators be granted discretionary authority and sole command beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 格不行。

translations.literal: It was blocked and not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was blocked and never implemented.

sentences.zh: 又疏劾大學士李時、禮部尚書夏言、工部尚書溫仁和、外戚蔣輪。

translations.literal: He again memorialized impeaching Grand Secretary Li Shi, Minister of Rites Xia Yan, Minister of Works Wen Renhe, and the imperial in-law Jiang Lun.
translations.idiomatic: He again memorialized impeaching Grand Secretary Li Shi, Minister of Rites Xia Yan, Minister of Works Wen Renhe, and the imperial in-law Jiang Lun.

sentences.zh: 進右給事中。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Right Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to right drafter.

sentences.zh: 郭勛請復鎮守內官，擅易置宿衛將校。

translations.literal: Guo Xun asked to restore resident eunuchs and on his own authority replaced palace guard officers.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Xun asked to restore resident eunuchs and on his own authority replaced palace guard officers.

sentences.zh: 薇憤，疏其不法七事。

translations.literal: Wei was indignant and memorialized seven illegal acts of his.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was indignant and memorialized seven of his illegal acts.

sentences.zh: 帝眷勛，然素知其橫，兩不問。

translations.literal: The Emperor favored Xun, yet had long known his overbearing ways, and punished neither side.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor favored Xun, yet had long known how overbearing he was, and took action against neither man.

sentences.zh: 已，因星變，極言主德之失，帝深銜之未發。

translations.literal: Later, on account of a celestial anomaly, he spoke at length of the sovereign's moral failings; the Emperor deeply resented it but did not yet act.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when a celestial anomaly occurred, he spoke at length of the sovereign's moral failings. The Emperor deeply resented it but did not yet act.

sentences.zh: 疏諫南巡，坐奪俸。

translations.literal: He memorialized remonstrating against the southern tour and was punished by loss of salary.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized against the southern tour and was punished by loss of salary.

sentences.zh: 內閣夏言輩所選宮僚，多以徇私劾罷。

translations.literal: He mostly impeached and dismissed for partiality the Eastern Palace staff chosen by Xia Yan and his fellows in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly impeached and had dismissed the Eastern Palace staff chosen by Xia Yan and his fellows in the Grand Secretariat, mostly on grounds of partiality.

sentences.zh: 薇偕同官呂應祥、任萬里乞如會推故事，集內閣九卿公舉。

translations.literal: Wei together with his colleagues Lü Yingxiang and Ren Wanli asked that, following the precedent of collective recommendation, the Grand Secretariat and the Nine Ministers jointly nominate candidates in public.
translations.idiomatic: Wei, together with his colleagues Lü Yingxiang and Ren Wanli, asked that appointments follow the precedent of collective recommendation, with the Grand Secretariat and the Nine Ministers nominating candidates jointly in public.

sentences.zh: 帝特命並斥為民。

translations.literal: The Emperor specially ordered all three dismissed and made commoners.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor specially ordered all three dismissed and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 累薦，皆報寢。

translations.literal: Repeated recommendations all received the reply that the matter was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: He was recommended again and again, but each memorial was shelved.

sentences.zh: 集鄉里晚進與講學，足跡不及公府。

translations.literal: He gathered the younger men of his home district to lecture on learning, and his footsteps never reached the offices of power.
translations.idiomatic: He gathered the younger men of his home district to lecture on learning, and never set foot in the halls of power.

sentences.zh: 倭患起，請於巡撫王忬，集兵為備。

translations.literal: When the Japanese raider threat arose, he asked Grand Coordinator Wang Yu to gather troops for defense.
translations.idiomatic: When the Japanese raider threat arose, he asked grand coordinator Wang Yu to gather troops for defense.

sentences.zh: 鄉人德之。

translations.literal: The people of his district were grateful to him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of his district were grateful to him.

sentences.zh: 卒年五十三。

translations.literal: He died at the age of fifty-three.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of fifty-three.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初贈太常少卿。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longqing he was posthumously granted Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Longqing reign he was posthumously granted vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 洪垣，字峻之，婺源人。

translations.literal: Hong Yuan, styled Junzhi, was from Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Yuan, courtesy name Junzhi, was from Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十一年進士。

translations.literal: A presented scholar in the eleventh year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the eleventh year of the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎湛若水講學京師，垣受業其門。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Zhan Ruoshui lectured in the capital; Yuan studied at his gate.
translations.idiomatic: When Vice Minister of Rites Zhan Ruoshui lectured in the capital, Yuan studied under him.

sentences.zh: 授永康知縣，征授御史。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Yongkang, then summoned and appointed Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Yongkang, then recalled to the capital and appointed censor.

sentences.zh: 十八年，世宗南巡，冊立皇太子，命閣臣夏言、顧鼎臣選宮僚。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when Shizong toured the south and invested the crown prince, he ordered Grand Secretaries Xia Yan and Gu Dingchen to select Eastern Palace staff.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when the Emperor toured the south and invested the crown prince, he ordered Grand Secretaries Xia Yan and Gu Dingchen to select Eastern Palace staff.

sentences.zh: 垣再疏言溫仁和、張衍慶、薛僑、胡守中、屠應飐、華察、胡經、史際、白悅、皇甫涍等皆庸流，不可使輔導青宮。

translations.literal: Yuan twice memorialized saying that Wen Renhe, Zhang Yanqing, Xue Qiao, Hu Shouzhong, Tu Yingran, Hua Cha, Hu Jing, Shi Ji, Bai Yue, Huangfu Qin, and others were all mediocre men unfit to guide the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan twice memorialized that Wen Renhe, Zhang Yanqing, Xue Qiao, Hu Shouzhong, Tu Yingran, Hua Cha, Hu Jing, Shi Ji, Bai Yue, Huangfu Qin, and others were all mediocre men unfit to guide the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 帝亦已從他諫官言，廢黜者數人。

translations.literal: The Emperor had already followed other remonstrating officials' words, and several men were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had already heeded other remonstrating officials, and several men were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，劾文選郎中黃禎先「賄選郎楊育秀，得為考功。

translations.literal: Before long he impeached Selection Director Huang Zhen, saying first that "he bribed Selection Clerk Yang Yuxiu and thereby obtained the post of Merit Examiner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he impeached Selection Director Huang Zhen, saying first that "he bribed Selection Clerk Yang Yuxiu and thereby obtained the post of merit examiner.

sentences.zh: 及居文選，貪婪欺罔。

translations.literal: Once he held the Selection office, he was greedy and deceitful.
translations.idiomatic: Once he held the Selection office, he was greedy and deceitful.

sentences.zh: 知州王顯祖等考察調簡，而補大州。

translations.literal: Prefect Wang Xianzu and others were rated in evaluation as fit for transfer to lesser posts, yet were assigned to greater prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Wang Xianzu and others were rated in evaluation as fit for transfer to lesser posts, yet were assigned to greater prefectures.

sentences.zh: 知縣何瑚年過六十，而選御史。

translations.literal: Magistrate He Hu was past sixty, yet was selected as censor.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate He Hu was past sixty, yet was selected as censor.

sentences.zh: 皆非制。

translations.literal: None of this accorded with regulation.
translations.idiomatic: None of this accorded with regulation.

sentences.zh: 今當大計京官，乃以猥瑣之曹世盛為考功郎，誤國甚」。

translations.literal: Now, when the grand evaluation of capital officials is at hand, he appoints the petty Cao Shisheng as Merit Examiner—a grave injury to the state."
translations.idiomatic: Now, when the grand evaluation of capital officials is at hand, he appoints the petty Cao Shisheng as merit examiner—a grave injury to the state."

sentences.zh: 帝下其章都察院，令會吏科參核。

translations.literal: The Emperor sent his memorial down to the Censorate and ordered it to investigate jointly with the Personnel Section.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sent his memorial to the Censorate and ordered a joint investigation with the Personnel section.

sentences.zh: 乃下禎詔獄，及育秀、顯祖等，鹹斥為民。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zhen was sent to the imperial prison, and Yuxiu, Xianzu, and the others were all dismissed and made commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Zhen was sent to the imperial prison, and Yuxiu, Xianzu, and the others were all dismissed and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 因詰責吏部尚書許贊、都御史王廷相，而令十三道御史公舉隱年冒進若瑚者。

translations.literal: The Emperor then rebuked Minister of Personnel Xu Zan and Censor-in-Chief Wang Tingxiang, and ordered censors of the thirteen circuits jointly to expose men who concealed their age to advance improperly, such as Hu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor then rebuked Minister of Personnel Xu Zan and censor-in-chief Wang Tingxiang, and ordered censors of the thirteen circuits jointly to expose men who concealed their age to advance improperly, such as Hu.

sentences.zh: 御史王之臣等坐調者四人，世盛亦改他部。

translations.literal: Censors Wang Zhichen and others—four men in all—were punished by transfer, and Shisheng was also moved to another ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Four censors, including Wang Zhichen, were punished by transfer, and Shisheng was also moved to another ministry.

sentences.zh: 垣一疏，而御史、曹郎以下得罪者至二十余人。

translations.literal: With one memorial from Yuan, more than twenty censors, bureau directors, and men below were punished.
translations.idiomatic: With a single memorial from Yuan, more than twenty censors, bureau directors, and men below were punished.

sentences.zh: 出按廣東。

translations.literal: He went out to inspect Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He went out to inspect Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 以安南款附，增俸一級。

translations.literal: Because Annam submitted in allegiance, his salary was raised one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Because Annam submitted in allegiance, his salary was raised one grade.

sentences.zh: 未竣，出為溫州知府。

translations.literal: Before his tour was complete, he was sent out as prefect of Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before his inspection tour was complete, he was sent out as prefect of Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 歲饑，有閉糴者，饑民殺之，垣坐落職歸。

translations.literal: In a year of famine someone hoarded grain; starving people killed him, and Yuan was demoted, stripped of office, and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of famine someone hoarded grain; starving people killed him, and Yuan was demoted, stripped of office, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 復與同里方瓘往從若水，若水為建二妙樓居之。

translations.literal: Again he went with his townsman Fang Guan to follow Ruoshui; Ruoshui built the Hall of Two Wonders for them to dwell in.
translations.idiomatic: Again he went with his townsman Fang Guan to study under Ruoshui, who built the Hall of Two Wonders for them to live in.

sentences.zh: 家食四十余年，年九十。

translations.literal: He lived at home without office for more than forty years, and reached the age of ninety.
translations.idiomatic: He lived in retirement at home for more than forty years and died at the age of ninety.

sentences.zh: 瓘絕意仕進。

translations.literal: Guan wholly abandoned any intent to pursue office.
translations.idiomatic: Guan gave up all thought of an official career.

sentences.zh: 嘗自廣東還，同行友瘴死。

translations.literal: Once, returning from Guangdong, a companion on the journey died of miasma.
translations.idiomatic: Once, on his way back from Guangdong, a traveling companion died of tropical fever.

sentences.zh: 舟中例不載屍，瓘秘不以告，與同寢累日，至韶州始發之。

translations.literal: By custom boats did not carry corpses; Guan kept this secret and did not tell anyone, sleeping beside the body for many days, and only at Shaozhou did he reveal it.
translations.idiomatic: Boats by custom did not carry corpses. Guan kept this secret and told no one, sleeping beside the body for days on end, and only at Shaozhou did he finally disclose it.

sentences.zh: 垣同年呂懷，廣信永豐人，亦若水高弟子。

translations.literal: Yuan's examination-year fellow Lu Huai, a man of Yongfeng in Guangxin, was likewise a leading disciple of Ruoshui.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan's examination-year fellow Lu Huai, from Yongfeng in Guangxin, was also a leading disciple of Zhan Ruoshui.

sentences.zh: 由庶吉士授兵科給事中，改春坊左司直郎，歷右中允，掌南京翰林院事。

translations.literal: From Hanlin Bachelor he was appointed Drafter of the Military Section, then transferred to Left Director of the Eastern Palace, served as Right Household Companion, and managed the affairs of the Nanjing Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: From Hanlin bachelor he was appointed drafter of the Military section, then transferred to left director of the Eastern Palace, served as right household companion, and oversaw the Nanjing Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 每言王氏之良知與湛氏體認天理同旨，其要在變化氣質。

translations.literal: He often said that Wang's innate knowledge and the Zhan school's apprehension of heavenly principle shared the same aim, and that the key lay in transforming one's native disposition.
translations.idiomatic: He often said that Wang Yangming's doctrine of innate moral knowledge and the Zhan school's method of apprehending heavenly principle pursued the same end, and that the essential point was to transform one's temperament.

sentences.zh: 作《心統圖說》以明之。

translations.literal: He wrote An Illustrated Explanation of the Heart's Governance to clarify this.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote An Illustrated Explanation of the Heart's Governance to expound it.

sentences.zh: 終南京太仆少卿。

translations.literal: He ended as Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He ended his career as vice director of the Court of the Imperial Stud at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 周思兼，字督夜，華亭人。

translations.literal: Zhou Sijian, styled Duye, was from Huating.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Sijian, courtesy name Duye, was from Huating.

sentences.zh: 少有文名。

translations.literal: In youth he had a literary reputation.
translations.idiomatic: He was known for his literary talent from an early age.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十六年進士。

translations.literal: A presented scholar in the twenty-sixth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the twenty-sixth year of the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 除平度知州。

translations.literal: He was appointed prefect of Pingdu.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed prefect of Pingdu.

sentences.zh: 躬巡郊野，坐藍輿中，攜飯一盂，令鄉民以次舁行。

translations.literal: He personally toured the countryside, seated in a blue sedan chair, carrying one bowl of food, and had villagers take turns bearing him along.
translations.idiomatic: He personally toured the countryside, seated in a blue sedan chair with a single bowl of food, and had villagers take turns carrying him from place to place.

sentences.zh: 因盡得閭閻疾苦狀，悉蠲除之。

translations.literal: Thereby he fully learned the hardships of the lanes and wards and abolished them all.
translations.idiomatic: In this way he learned the full extent of the people's hardships and remitted every burden he could.

sentences.zh: 王府奄人縱莊奴奪民產，監司杖奴斃，奄迫王奏聞，巡撫彭黯令思兼讞之。

translations.literal: A eunuch of the princely estate let estate bondsmen seize commoners' property; the supervising official caned a bondsman to death; the eunuch pressured the prince to memorialize the throne; Grand Coordinator Peng An ordered Sijian to review the case.
translations.idiomatic: A eunuch of the princely estate let estate bondsmen seize commoners' property. The supervising official caned a bondsman to death, and the eunuch pressured the prince to memorial the throne. Grand coordinator Peng An ordered Sijian to review the case.

sentences.zh: 王置酒欲有所囑，竟席不敢言。

translations.literal: The prince set out wine wishing to give some instruction, but through the whole banquet Sijian did not dare speak.
translations.idiomatic: The prince set out wine hoping to press his wishes upon him, but Sijian did not dare speak a word through the entire banquet.

sentences.zh: 思兼閱獄詞曰：「此決杖不如法。

translations.literal: Sijian reviewed the case records and said: "This execution by beating was not in accord with law.
translations.idiomatic: Sijian reviewed the case records and said: "This execution by beating was not lawful.

sentences.zh: 罪當杖，以王故，加一等。

translations.literal: The crime warranted beating; on account of the prince, increase one degree.
translations.idiomatic: The crime warranted beating; on account of the prince, increase the penalty one degree.

sentences.zh: 奄誣告，罪當戍，以王故，末減。

translations.literal: The eunuch's false accusation warranted border service; on account of the prince, reduce at the lowest degree.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch's false accusation warranted border service; on account of the prince, reduce the penalty at the lowest degree.

sentences.zh: 」監司竟得復故秩。

translations.literal: " The supervising official in the end recovered his former rank.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end the supervising official recovered his former rank.

sentences.zh: 旁郡饑民掠食，所司持之急，且為亂，上官檄思兼治之。

translations.literal: In neighboring prefectures starving people looted food; the responsible officials pressed them harshly, and disorder was imminent; the superior sent an order for Sijian also to handle it.
translations.idiomatic: In neighboring prefectures starving people were looting food. The responsible officials pressed them harshly, and rebellion was imminent, so the superior ordered Sijian to handle the matter as well.

sentences.zh: 作小木牌數千散四郊，令執牌就撫，悉振以錢谷，事遂定。

translations.literal: He made several thousand small wooden placards and scattered them through the four suburbs, ordering those who held the placards to come forward for relief; he supplied them all with money and grain, and the affair was settled.
translations.idiomatic: He made several thousand small wooden placards and distributed them through the countryside, telling holders to come forward for relief. He supplied them all with money and grain, and the crisis was resolved.

sentences.zh: 入覲，舉治行第一，當遷。

translations.literal: On presenting himself at court, his record of governance was ranked first and he was due for transfer.
translations.idiomatic: When he presented himself at court, his record of governance was ranked first and he was due for promotion.

sentences.zh: 州人走闕下以請，乃復留一年。

translations.literal: The people of the prefecture went to the capital to petition, and he was kept on for another year.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the prefecture went to the capital to petition on his behalf, and he was kept in office for another year.

sentences.zh: 擢工部員外郎，督臨清磚廠，士民遮道泣送。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and supervised the brickworks at Linqing; gentry and commoners blocked the road weeping as they saw him off.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director of the Ministry of Works and put in charge of the brickworks at Linqing. Gentry and commoners blocked the road weeping as they saw him off.

sentences.zh: 同年生貌類思兼，使經平度，民競走謁。

translations.literal: An examination-year fellow whose appearance resembled Sijian passed through Pingdu, and the people all ran to pay their respects.
translations.idiomatic: An examination-year fellow who resembled Sijian in appearance passed through Pingdu, and the people all rushed out to greet him.

sentences.zh: 見非是，各嘆息去。

translations.literal: Seeing it was not he, each sighed and departed.
translations.idiomatic: When they saw it was not he, each sighed and went away.

sentences.zh: 河將決，思兼募民築堤，身立赤日中。

translations.literal: The river was about to breach; Sijian recruited the people to build dikes, and himself stood in the blazing sun.
translations.idiomatic: When the river was about to breach its banks, Sijian recruited the people to build dikes and himself stood in the blazing sun.

sentences.zh: 堤成三日而秋漲大發，民免於災。

translations.literal: Three days after the dikes were finished the autumn flood rose greatly, and the people were spared disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Three days after the dikes were finished, the autumn flood surged, and the people were spared disaster.

sentences.zh: 進郎中，出為湖廣僉事。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Bureau Director and sent out as Vice Commissioner of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to bureau director and sent out as vice commissioner of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 岷府宗室五人封爵皆將軍，殺人掠貲財，監司避不入武岡者二十年。

translations.literal: Five members of the Min princely clan, all ennobled as generals, killed people and plundered wealth; supervising officials had avoided entering Wugang for twenty years.
translations.idiomatic: Five members of the Min princely clan, all ennobled as generals, murdered and plundered at will. Supervising officials had avoided entering Wugang for twenty years.

sentences.zh: 思兼廉得奸狀，縛其黨，悉系之獄。

translations.literal: Sijian thoroughly investigated and obtained proof of their wicked acts, bound their followers, and imprisoned them all.
translations.idiomatic: Sijian thoroughly investigated and uncovered their crimes, bound their followers, and imprisoned them all.

sentences.zh: 五人藏利刃入，思兼與揖，而捫其臂曰：「吾為將軍百口計，將軍乃為此曹死耶？

translations.literal: The five men entered with hidden blades; Sijian bowed in greeting while feeling their arms and said: "I am thinking of the safety of your households, Generals—will you die for these fellows?
translations.idiomatic: The five men entered with hidden blades. Sijian bowed in greeting while feeling their arms and said: "I am thinking of the safety of your entire households, Generals—will you throw your lives away for these men?

sentences.zh: 」皆沮退。

translations.literal: " All were discouraged and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: " All were discouraged and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 乃列其罪奏聞，悉錮之高墻，還田宅子女於民。

translations.literal: Thereupon he listed their crimes and memorialized the throne; all were confined within high walls, and fields, houses, and dependents were returned to the people.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he listed their crimes and memorialized the throne. All were confined within high walls, and fields, houses, and dependents were returned to the people.

sentences.zh: 遭內艱去官，不復出。

translations.literal: Upon mourning for his mother he left office and never returned.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died he left office and never served again.

sentences.zh: 居久之，起廣西提學副使，未聞命而卒。

translations.literal: After living in retirement for a long time, he was recalled as Vice Commissioner for Education in Guangxi, but died before the appointment reached him.
translations.idiomatic: After living in retirement for a long time, he was recalled as vice commissioner for education in Guangxi, but died before the appointment reached him.

sentences.zh: 顏鯨，字應雷，慈溪人。

translations.literal: Yan Jing, styled Yinglei, was from Cixi.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Jing, courtesy name Yinglei, was from Cixi.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三十五年進士。

translations.literal: A presented scholar in the thirty-fifth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the thirty-fifth year of the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 授行人。

translations.literal: He was appointed Courier.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed courier.

sentences.zh: 擢御史，出視倉場。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Censor and sent out to inspect the granaries.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to censor and sent out to inspect the granaries.

sentences.zh: 奸人馬漢怙定國公勢，貸子錢漕卒。

translations.literal: The villain Ma Han relied on the power of the Duke of Dingguo and lent money at usury to grain-transport corvée laborers.
translations.idiomatic: The villain Ma Han relied on the power of the Duke of Dingguo to lend money at usury to grain-transport corvée laborers.

sentences.zh: 償不時，則沒入其糧，為怨家所訴。

translations.literal: When repayment was not timely, he confiscated their grain allotment, and an enemy brought suit against him.
translations.idiomatic: When repayment was not made on time, he confiscated their grain allotment, and an enemy brought suit against him.

sentences.zh: 漢持定國書至，鯨立論殺之。

translations.literal: Han brought a letter from the Duke of Dingguo; Jing immediately argued for his execution.
translations.idiomatic: Han brought a letter from the Duke of Dingguo, but Jing immediately argued for his execution.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，畿輔、山東西、河南北大諗。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year, the capital region, eastern and western Shandong, and northern Henan suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year, the capital region, eastern and western Shandong, and northern Henan suffered great famine.

sentences.zh: 鯨請州縣贓罰銀毋輸京師，盡易粟備振，且發之。

translations.literal: Jing asked that silver from corruption fines in prefectures and counties not be sent to the capital, but wholly exchanged for grain to prepare relief and distributed at once.
translations.idiomatic: Jing asked that silver from corruption fines in prefectures and counties not be sent to the capital, but wholly exchanged for grain for famine relief and distributed at once.

sentences.zh: 內府新錢為糴本。

translations.literal: New coin from the inner treasury was to serve as capital for buying grain.
translations.idiomatic: New coin from the inner treasury was to serve as capital for buying grain.

sentences.zh: 帝悉報可。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved all of it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved all of it.

sentences.zh: 已，上漕政便宜六事。

translations.literal: Soon after, he submitted six expedient measures for grain transport administration.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, he submitted six expedient measures for grain transport administration.

sentences.zh: 明年出按河南。

translations.literal: The next year he went out to inspect Henan.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he went out to inspect Henan.

sentences.zh: 伊王典楧怙惡，久結掖廷中官、嚴嵩父子，內外應援，所請奏立下，爪牙率礦盜。

translations.literal: The Prince of Yi, Dianyuan, relied on his wickedness; long allied with palace eunuchs and Yan Song and his son, with support inside and out, whatever he requested was memorialized and immediately granted; his henchmen were mostly mine robbers.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yi, Zhu Dianyuan, relied on his wickedness. Long allied with palace eunuchs and Yan Song and his son, with support inside and outside the court, whatever he requested was memorialized and immediately granted, and his henchmen were mostly mine robbers.

sentences.zh: 鯨欲除之，與參政耿隨卿計，持王承奉王钅盬罪，钅盬日告王所謀。

translations.literal: Jing wished to eliminate him; with Vice Commissioner Geng Suiqing he plotted to seize upon the crimes of the prince's palace attendant Wang Jian; Jian daily reported the prince's schemes.
translations.idiomatic: Jing wished to eliminate him. With vice commissioner Geng Suiqing he plotted to seize upon the crimes of the prince's palace attendant Wang Jian, who daily reported the prince's schemes.

sentences.zh: 時嵩已敗，鯨乃奏記徐階，說諸大珰絕其援，又盡捕王偵事飛騎。

translations.literal: By then Yan Song had already fallen; Jing then sent a letter to Xu Jie, persuading the chief eunuchs to cut off his support, and also captured all the prince's mounted scouts.
translations.idiomatic: By then Yan Song had already fallen. Jing sent a letter to Xu Jie, persuading the chief eunuchs to cut off the prince's support, and also captured all the prince's mounted scouts.

sentences.zh: 托言防寇，檄知府兵分屯要害地。

translations.literal: Under the pretext of guarding against bandits, he issued orders for the prefect's troops to garrison strategic points.
translations.idiomatic: Under the pretext of guarding against bandits, he ordered the prefect's troops to garrison strategic points.

sentences.zh: 乃會巡撫胡堯臣劾典楧抗旨、矯敕、僭擬、淫虐十大罪。

translations.literal: Thereupon, joining Grand Coordinator Hu Yaochan, he impeached Dianyuan on ten counts: resisting imperial orders, forging edicts, overstepping prerogatives, and debauchery and cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon, joining grand coordinator Hu Yaochan, he impeached Zhu Dianyuan on ten counts: resisting imperial orders, forging edicts, overstepping prerogatives, and debauchery and cruelty.

sentences.zh: 王護衛及諸亡命幾萬人，不敢發。

translations.literal: The prince's guard and various fugitives numbered nearly ten thousand, but dared not rise.
translations.idiomatic: The prince's guard and various fugitives numbered nearly ten thousand, but dared not rise.

sentences.zh: 帝震怒，廢王為庶人，錮之高墻，沒其貲，削世封。

translations.literal: The Emperor was greatly angered, degraded the prince to commoner status, confined him within high walls, confiscated his wealth, and stripped his hereditary enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was greatly angered. He degraded the prince to commoner status, confined him within high walls, confiscated his wealth, and stripped his hereditary enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 兩河人鼓舞相慶。

translations.literal: The people of the two Henans rejoiced and celebrated one another.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the two Henans rejoiced and celebrated together.

sentences.zh: 景王之國，越界奪民產為莊田，鯨執治其爪牙。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Jing took up his fief, he crossed boundaries to seize commoners' property as estate lands; Jing prosecuted his henchmen.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Jing took up his fief, he crossed boundaries to seize commoners' property as estate lands, and Jing prosecuted his henchmen.

sentences.zh: 魏國公侵民產，假欽賜名樹碑為界。

translations.literal: The Duke of Wei encroached on commoners' property and, falsely invoking an imperial bestowal, erected a stele as a boundary marker.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Wei encroached on commoners' property and, falsely invoking an imperial grant, erected a stele to mark the boundary.

sentences.zh: 鯨仆其碑，戍其人。

translations.literal: Jing toppled the stele and sentenced the man to border service.
translations.idiomatic: Jing toppled the stele and sentenced the man to border service.

sentences.zh: 錦衣帥受諸俠少金，署名校尉籍中，為民害。

translations.literal: The Embroidered Uniform Guard commander accepted gold from various young ruffians and registered their names in the guard roster, harming the people.
translations.idiomatic: The Embroidered Uniform Guard commander accepted bribes from various young ruffians and registered their names in the guard roster, to the people's harm.

sentences.zh: 列侯使王府，道路驛騷。

translations.literal: When marquises were sent on missions to princely estates, the roads and post stations were thrown into turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: When marquises were sent on missions to princely estates, the roads and post stations were thrown into turmoil.

sentences.zh: 王府內官進奉，駕龍舟，所過恣橫。

translations.literal: When palace attendants of princely estates went to present tribute, they rode dragon boats and acted with reckless violence wherever they passed.
translations.idiomatic: When palace attendants of princely estates went to present tribute, they rode dragon boats and acted with reckless violence wherever they passed.

sentences.zh: 鯨請校尉缺從兵部補，冊封改文臣，王府進奉遣屬吏。

translations.literal: Jing asked that guard vacancies be filled from the Ministry of War, that investiture missions use civil officials, and that princely tribute missions send subordinate clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Jing asked that guard vacancies be filled from the Ministry of War, that investiture missions use civil officials, and that princely tribute missions send subordinate clerks.

sentences.zh: 詔冊親王及妃遣列侯，余皆如鯨議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that for investing princes and consorts marquises be sent; all else followed Jing's proposals.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that marquises be sent only to invest princes and consorts; all else followed Jing's proposals.

sentences.zh: 鯨按河南時，黜新鄭知縣，其人高拱所庇也。

translations.literal: When Jing inspected Henan, he dismissed the magistrate of Xinzheng, a man under Gao Gong's protection.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing inspected Henan, he dismissed the magistrate of Xinzheng, a man under Gao Gong's protection.

sentences.zh: 在湖廣，王篆欲祀其父鄉賢，執不許。

translations.literal: In Huguang, Wang Zhuan wished to enshrine his father among local worthies; Jing steadfastly refused.
translations.idiomatic: In Huguang, Wang Zhuan wished to enshrine his father among local worthies, but Jing steadfastly refused.

sentences.zh: 至是，拱掌吏部，篆為考功，遂以不謹落鯨職。

translations.literal: At this time Gong controlled the Ministry of Personnel and Zhuan served as Merit Examiner; on grounds of lack of prudence they stripped Jing of office.
translations.idiomatic: By then Gong controlled the Ministry of Personnel and Zhuan served as merit examiner; on grounds of lack of prudence they stripped Jing of office.

sentences.zh: 萬歷中，給事中鄒元標、御史饒位交章薦之，報寢。

translations.literal: In the Wanli reign, Drafter Zou Yuanbiao and Censor Rao Wei submitted successive memorials recommending him, but received the reply that the matter was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wanli reign, drafter Zou Yuanbiao and censor Rao Wei submitted successive memorials recommending him, but each was shelved.

sentences.zh: 御史顧雲程言：「陛下大起遺佚，獨鯨及管誌道以考察格之。

translations.literal: Censor Gu Yuncheng said: "Your Majesty is greatly raising overlooked men, yet Jing and Guan Zhidao alone are blocked by evaluation records.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Gu Yuncheng said: "Your Majesty is greatly raising overlooked men, yet Jing and Guan Zhidao alone are blocked by evaluation records.

sentences.zh: 夫相與冢宰賢，則黜幽為公典，否則驅除異己而已。

translations.literal: If the chief minister is worthy together with the chancellor, then dismissing the obscure is a public norm; otherwise it is merely driving out those unlike oneself.
translations.idiomatic: If the chief minister is worthy together with the chancellor, then dismissing the obscure is a public norm; otherwise it is merely driving out those unlike oneself.

sentences.zh: 近又登用被察吳中行、艾穆、魏時亮、趙世卿，獨靳鯨、誌道何也？

translations.literal: Recently Wu Zhonghang, Ai Mu, Wei Shiliang, and Zhao Shiqing, all men who had been evaluated and dismissed, were again appointed—why alone withhold Jing and Zhidao?
translations.idiomatic: Recently Wu Zhonghang, Ai Mu, Wei Shiliang, and Zhao Shiqing, all men who had been evaluated and dismissed, were again appointed—why alone withhold Jing and Zhidao?

sentences.zh: 」給事中姜應麟、李弘道亦言之，僅以湖廣副使致仕。

translations.literal: " Drafters Jiang Yinglin and Li Hongdao also spoke on it; he was granted only retirement as Vice Commissioner of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: " Drafters Jiang Yinglin and Li Hongdao also spoke on it, but he was granted only retirement as vice commissioner of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 中外論薦十余疏，不果用。

translations.literal: Inside and outside the court more than ten memorials recommending him were submitted, but he was not employed.
translations.idiomatic: Inside and outside the court more than ten memorials recommending him were submitted, but he was never employed.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：傳稱：「未信而諫，則以為謗己」。

translations.literal: The commentary says: The Classic says: "If one remonstrates before trust is established, it is taken as slander against oneself."
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: The Classic says: "If one remonstrates before trust is established, it is taken as slander against oneself."

sentences.zh: 然誌節之士，忄卷忄卷忠愛，何忍以不信自外其君哉？

translations.literal: Yet men of steadfast integrity, with earnest loyal devotion—how could they bear to hold themselves apart from their lord through disbelief?
translations.idiomatic: Yet men of steadfast integrity, with earnest loyal devotion—how could they bear to hold themselves apart from their lord through disbelief?

sentences.zh: 張芹等懷抱悃忱，激昂論事。

translations.literal: Zhang Qin and the others harbored sincere devotion and spoke on affairs with passionate force.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qin and the others harbored sincere devotion and spoke on affairs with passionate force.

sentences.zh: 其言雖不盡用，要與緘默者異矣。

translations.literal: Though their words were not wholly adopted, they were after all unlike those who kept silent.
translations.idiomatic: Though their words were not wholly adopted, they were after all unlike those who kept silent.
